Job Description
We are looking for a seasoned and highly capable Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team. In this key role, you will be responsible for protecting the organisation’s systems, networks, and data against evolving cyber threats. Your deep knowledge of cyber security frameworks, risk management, incident response, and operational security will be essential in maintaining our security posture and meeting regulatory requirements. This is a great opportunity to take the lead on critical cyber security initiatives while guiding and mentoring junior team members.
Responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cyber security strategies and initiatives
Conduct regular security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend appropriate controls and countermeasures
Monitor and analyse security events, alerts, and logs to detect and respond to potential threats and breaches
Lead incident response efforts, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery, ensuring timely and effective resolution
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement secure infrastructure, systems, and applications
Conduct security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
Provide guidance and support in the development and implementation of security policies, standards, and procedures
Stay up to date with the latest cyber security threats, trends, and technologies, and recommend proactive measures to enhance our security posture
Mentor and provide guidance to junior members of the cyber security team, promoting professional growth and development
Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR)
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Must have at least 2 years of proven work experience as a Cyber Security Analyst, with a focus on security operations, incident response, and risk assessment
In-depth knowledge of cyber security principles, frameworks, and best practices
Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and threat intelligence platforms
Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment tools, and secure coding practices
Strong understanding of network security, firewall configuration, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and security tool integration
Familiarity with cloud security principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex security issues and recommend effective solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or GIAC certifications are highly desirable
Proven leadership skills, with the ability to lead and mentor junior team members
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super

The Australian Automotive Group (AAG)
  
  
Position  : Full Time
Salar y    : $75,000 - $85,000 a year
Location : Sydney
  
  
The Australian Automotive Group (AAG) has evolved into an outstanding portfolio of automotive assets. The core of which is the six leading Ford dealerships in Sydney. The Ford portfolio has been complemented by the addition of Suzuki, Renault, Mitsubishi, Hyundai, Isuzu and Kia.
  
Australian Automotive Group is currently looking for experienced, motivated, and enthusiastic for ICT Support Technician to join their head office in Alexandria NSW.

Their dealerships in Sydney are: Brad Garlick Ford, Castle Hill Renault, City Ford Sydney, City Ford Rockdale, Cumberland Ford, Cumberland Suzuki, Power Ford, Titan Ford, Brookvale Mitsubishi, Ryde Hyundai, Castle Hill Isuzu Ute, Ryde Isuzu Ute, and Rockdale City Kia.
  
The role will involve the following:
Provide technical support to employees via phone, email, remote access, or onsite.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
Set up and manage user accounts, passwords, email accounts, and access permissions
Install, configure, and update operating systems and business applications.
Support dealership management systems
Maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and network devices.
Assist with cybersecurity by applying software updates, antivirus protection, and security policies.
Assist with server maintenance, backup verification, and disaster recovery procedures.
Document IT procedures, troubleshooting guides, and system configurations.
Ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and data privacy requirements.
  
The successful candidate will need the following:
Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience
Relevant qualification
Strong knowledge and troubleshooting of Microsoft Windows and Service OS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Entra ID and Azure knowledge is highly regarded
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer service focus with the ability to support users of varying technical abilities.
Good organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate documentation. 


If you think this role is right for you, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: $81,748.17 - $114,771.98 per annum, pro rata (+ super + 17.5% leave loading where applicable)
Hours per Week: Up to 27 
Applications Close: 5 August 2026
Vaccination Category: A 
Located in: Site negotiable within MLHD

Supporting Dignity, Independence and Wellbeing.

About the Opportunity
Are you a compassionate and community-focused Registered Nurse seeking a rewarding role in Continence Care?
MLHD are offering a motivated Registered Nurse the chance to apply there skills across Griffith, Hay, Hillston, Lake Cargelligo, Leeton, Barham, Deniliquin, Finley, Jerilderie, Mathoura, Moama, Moulamein, Tooleybuc and surrounds of MLHD, in Continence care

As the Registered Nurse, you will:
Provide comprehensive, coordinated and person-centred nursing care to individuals and families within their homes and community settings. Provide a client goal focused service to empower them to achieve their health goals
Delivering broad knowledge, education and care in everything in continence
You will work collaboratively with consumers, carers, General Practitioners and multidisciplinary teams to ensure continuity of care and optimal health outcomes.

To find out more, please review the Position Description

About You

Our ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia via AHPRA

Experience or interest in community nursing, including chronic disease management and post-acute care

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build therapeutic relationships with individuals, families, carers and multidisciplinary teams

Ability to conduct comprehensive assessments, develop and evaluate person-centred care plans, and deliver safe, evidence-based nursing care in community and home-based settings

Why join MLHD

At Murrumbidgee Local Health District (MLHD), we offer more than a job, we offer the chance to make a real difference.

Make a Meaningful Impact - Play a vital role in delivering essential health services to our diverse and vibrant regional communities.

Attractive Remuneration - Enjoy competitive pay aligned with your skills and experience.

Generous Salary Packaging - Access up to $20,600 per annum tax-free for living expenses, plus the option for novated car leasing.

Professional Development - Take advantage of ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

Health & Wellbeing Support - Benefit from our comprehensive wellness programs for you and your family, including Employee Assistance Programs, Fitness Passport, and initiatives to support both physical and mental health.

Click here to discover why MLHD is the right place to grow your career and contribute to healthier communities.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the opportunity for you, click apply now! Please contact Contact Stephanie Krause, Nurse Manager on Stephanie.Krause@health.nsw.gov.au , if you have any questions about this role.

MLHD welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and is committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve.
We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and the LGBTIQ+ community.

If you identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander, you can access recruitment application support through the Stepping Up initiative.

This is a NSW Health Category A position which requires immunisation and screening for certain diseases. The full list of requirements are outlined in the NSW Health OASV Policy (Page 11). You will be required to complete the OASV Undertaking- Declaration Form and TB Assessment Tool during the recruitment process. Please upload this with your application along with any other vaccination evidence that you may have.

Join MEGT as a Business Administration Trainee!    Are you a motivated, organised, and customer-focused individual looking to launch your career in business administration? MEGT has a fantastic opportunity with one of our valued clients,  Accu Weigh , in partnership with  Diverseco , for a  Business Administration Traineeship  located in  Rowville, VIC .    About the role    This full-time traineeship provides the opportunity to gain practical, hands-on experience while completing a  Certificate III in Business . As a Business Administration Trainee, you'll support the day-to-day operations of the business and develop valuable skills across administration, customer service and office coordination.    Your duties will include:  
 
 Providing general administration support, including managing calls, emails and business documentation. 
 Assisting with customer service, scheduling appointments and coordinating office activities. 
 Processing invoices, purchase orders and expense claims while supporting accounts administration. 
 Preparing reports, spreadsheets and correspondence while maintaining accurate business records. 
 
  What we're looking for  
 
 Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail. 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook. 
 A proactive, professional attitude with the ability to multitask and work collaboratively. 
 Previous administration, customer service or data entry experience is desirable but not essential. 
 
  What can you expect from us?  
 
 Personalised one-on-one mentoring throughout your traineeship. 
 A nationally recognised qualification. 
 Fortnightly pay. 
 Comprehensive TAFE training leading to a Certificate III in Business. 
 Ongoing professional development and career opportunities. 
 
  About the company    Accu Weigh, in partnership with Diverseco, is a trusted Australian provider of industrial weighing, automation and measurement solutions. Together, they deliver innovative products and services to customers across a broad range of industries. You'll join a supportive and collaborative team where you'll gain valuable hands-on experience while building a strong foundation for a successful career in business administration.    Interested?  Click "Apply Now" or for more information or visit  https://    https://www.megt.com.au/jobs     At MEGT, we enable people to start their careers through Apprenticeships and Traineeships and support large and small businesses to recruit, train and grow careers. Our purpose is to provide life changing, lifelong learning and employment solutions for all. We invite you to be part of our story. By applying, you agree to receive information about other MEGT employment and education opportunities    MEGT is committed to being a Child Safe Organisation and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We have zero tolerance of racism, discrimination, harm, or abuse. We have a culture that values safety, diversity, and inclusion and encourage all qualified applicants, including minorities, genders, protected veterans, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
